title: Difficult Person Test
description: How difficult do others find you? Look at 7 hidden antagonistic traits you might not be aware of.

questions.dpt_1: I don't feel the need to care much about other people's problems or feelings.
questions.dpt_2: I find it hard to sincerely sympathize when I see others struggling.
questions.dpt_3: My parents or friends have told me I lack empathy.
questions.dpt_4: I feel I deserve special treatment compared to most people.
questions.dpt_5: Deep down, I feel smarter or better than most people.
questions.dpt_6: I really enjoy being the center of attention and admired by others.
questions.dpt_7: I'm easily provoked and sometimes explode when I'm angry.
questions.dpt_8: I often use threats, shouting, or anger to get what I want.
questions.dpt_9: I love sharp debates and beating others in an argument.
questions.dpt_10: I find it very hard to trust that others mean well toward me.
questions.dpt_11: I often feel others are secretly talking badly about me or planning something against me.
questions.dpt_12: I'm very cautious and always suspicious when new people are too nice to me.
questions.dpt_13: I often look for loopholes or manipulate situations to benefit myself.
questions.dpt_14: I sometimes deliberately twist the facts (gaslighting) so I don't get blamed for a mistake.
questions.dpt_15: I can be very sweet to someone just because I want something from them.
questions.dpt_16: When working in a team, I feel I have to be the one controlling and organizing everything.
questions.dpt_17: I get very annoyed when others refuse to follow my instructions or suggestions.
questions.dpt_18: I always try to dominate conversations and decision-making in a group.
questions.dpt_19: I often do reckless or high-risk things without thinking about the consequences for myself or others.
questions.dpt_20: I get bored easily and keep looking for new thrills that are risky or even break the rules.
questions.dpt_21: Rules and social norms feel like restrictions that I often want to break.

results.description: You tend to be tolerant and empathetic, and rarely cause unnecessary friction.
You have some firm or defensive traits that sometimes make it hard for others to compromise with you.
You have many antagonistic traits (such as dominance, suspicion, or aggression) that can make interactions with you exhausting for others.
